_about: How tense the game is, from what the vision engine reports. The intensity is an accumulator in the shape of Left 4 Dead's director (Booth, GDC 2009): events push it up, it decays with time, and the decay pauses while HP keeps falling. The tempo is the band the intensity falls in. Every number here is tuned by replaying sessions, never in code.

events._hp_under_half_per_second: only while HP fell within hold_decay_while_losing_hp_for_s
